_about: Per-lane defaults for a project's title card (scripts/title_card.py propose). The house rule, 2026-10-26 (the titles and motion proposal of 2026-10-26 [studio history]): the card is the permission list (C3) — only the kinds it names are rendered, captions stay on regardless; no overshoot on any text, number or UI (C2); a title enters after the clip's head settle unless it is declared to mask it (C1). The fonts are the brand's, never a default: propose leaves them for the client profile or the flags to fill, and lint refuses a card without real font files. Every number marked [assumed] waits for approved ads to calibrate it.
_sizes: scale.base_px is the label size at a 1920-px-tall frame; the steps are label = base, body = base·r, title = base·r², hero = base·r³, display = base·r⁴ (one scale, one ratio: Stocks, Universal Principles of Typography). Other frame heights scale proportionally.
_native: v2.45 (2026-10-29; house rule C7, and the author: 'It keeps making mp4s which it imports'): these tokens are what scripts/fusion_titles.py writes into each kind's GENERATED Fusion title — no token changed. Made natively: the anchor face and its Style (the weight as a name: 700 Bold), the style frame's Text+ Size per kind, the ink on paper or footage, tracking (CharacterSpacing 1 + tracking_em), a kind's plate (colors.plate on Text+ element 3), an end card's page_bg (an opaque Background), and the motion — enter fade-rise (Blend 0→1 and a 1.2 % rise), tracking-in (CharacterSpacing from +0.25), blur-resolve (never ads) or cut; exit fade, fade-up or cut — as keyframes whose Bézier handles ARE the card's cubic-bezier (no overshoot: C2), keyed at frame 0, with the exit folded onto the clip's last frames by a TimeStretcher. Approximated, and `title_card.py titles` WARNS on each: per-word and mask-reveal enter as fade-rise (the lines together), stagger_ms is not applied, a stat lands on its value without count_ms, the highlighter sits behind every line rather than the one word, and the underline mark is not drawn. A look that needs them is the owner's call (engine hyperframes with their words as the engine_reason).
